Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[CargoPortsTutorial:
**Auxiliary Gates are extra entry and exit points to the Port Area.**

Each Main Gate has two types of Auxiliary gates to provide more control and flexibility to traffic management in the Port Area.

You can build as many of these as you like.
Container Cranes built on top of quays or harbor roads allow loading and unloading of cargo ships.
Cargo Warehouses can store all types of resources in large amounts.
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[InlandFishFarmingT:
**Inland Fish Farming is a way to produce fish on land in large tanks of water.**

Because the tanks are on land they are susceptible to pollution from nearby industries and other land polluting buildings.

**Inland Fish Farm Hub can be placed anywhere on land.**

There's a road connection point on the front and a fish tank area on the back.  

**Build your hub building and define the farm area in the back.**

To define the farm area, start placing nodes to form any shape you like inside the circled area. Complete the area by connecting the other end of the line to the opposite edge of the building in the back.

You can't define the area over the building and you can't build roads inside the area, so you will need to leave enough room in the front for your're road connection.

**When the area is completed, a company will move in and start production. Tanks will appear in the farming area when production has started.**

You can go back and adjust the fish farm area with the Specialized Industry Area Tool at any time.
Tutorials.TRIGGER[InlandFishFarmingTutor: Build a Hub and Define the Farm Area
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[InlandFishFarmingT:
**Your Fish Farm will need a road connection.**

Remember to check that your farm is connected to a road. 

**If you haven't build the farm on an existing road, build one for it.**

The road connection will give access to the building. Everything that the farm needs will come through the road connection. Water, electricity, people and shipments in and out.

Select the Inland Fish Farming hub building to access the building upgrades.

Upgrades include extra buildings to the fish farming area.

**You'll need to close the Zones Menu to be able to select the building.**

The hub building upgrades include three different sizes of cold storage units.

**Each unit expands the company's storage space.**

The storage buildings don't need a road connection to work, and you can build as many storage units as you like with in the range of the hub building.

**Placement range is indicated with a circle around the hub building.**
Tutorials.TITLE[OpenWaterFishFarmingTuto: Fishing and Open Water Fish Farming
Fishing and Open Water Fish Farming
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OpenWaterFishFarmi:
**Open water fish industry includes two area types: Fishing Area and Open Water Fish Farming Area.**

Fishing Area is a designated area where fisherman can catch fish.

Open Water Fish Farm is a collection of cages and net pens to farm fish in.

You can build your fish production area with just one type of area or mix and match both types.
Tutorials.TITLE[OpenWaterFishFarmingTuto: Building the Fishing and Open Water Fish Farming Hub
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OpenWaterFishFarmi:
**Find a suitable place on the shoreline, close to areas with a high fish population.**

Use the Natural Resource info view to find where the fish populations are and build you hub near it.
 
**Note** Open Water Fish Farming Area doesn't require an area with high fish population.

**Fishing and Open Water Fish Farming Hub requires a road connection.**

Employees and resource trucks use the road to access the building. 

Remember build a good road connection for smooth operation, if you haven't already done so.

**When the road is connected a company can move in and start production.**

Select the Hub Building you've just build, to open the upgrade menu.

The upgrade menu includes important additions to the hub building that are required for the fish production to function.

**You'll need to close the Zones Menu first to be able to select the Building.**

Fishing Pier is a place for boats to duck and offload their catch.

You will need to extend the pier from your hub to reach further to the water, so boats will have enough room to dock.

**Build the Fishing Harbor Pier from the pier stub included in the hub building and extend it towards the open water.**

Once the pier is long enough, boatways are created to both sides of the pier.

**Open Water Fish Farm is a collection of cages and net pens to farm fish in.**

After a company has moved in to the Hub Building and started production, fishing boats will visit the area to collect the produced fish.
Tutorials.TITLE[OpenWaterFishFarmingTuto: Building an Open Water Fish Farming Area
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OpenWaterFishFarmi:
You can build the Farming Area anywhere on water. Fish Farming area doesn't need a concentration of fish in the water.

A large circle represents how far away from the hub building you can build the fish farm.

A smaller circle around the starting area is how big of an area you can define for the farming cages and pens.

**On one side of the starting area there's a connection point for a boatway. The box shape is your fish farm area that can be extended and defined to any shape.**

You can't build your farming are over this connection point, and boatways can't be build inside the farm area, so make sure you leave enough room for the boatway to be connected later.

**Build your farm anywhere in water and define the farming area.**

Fish Farming Area is defined by placing nodes in any shape you like and then completing the area by selecting the opposite edge of the area.

**Fishing Area is a designated area where fisherman can catch fish.**

Fishing Area requires good concentration of fish in the area to operate. The Natural Resource info view shows where the fish populations are located.

You can build the Fishing Area anywhere on water. Fishing Area needs a concentration of fish in the water.

A large circle represents how far away from the hub building you can build the fishing area.

A smaller circle around the starting area is how big of an area you can define for the fishing boats to fish in.

**On one side of the starting area there's a connection point for a boatway. The box shape is your fishing area that can be extended and defined to any shape.**

You can't build your fishing are over this connection point, and boatways can't be build inside the fishing area, so make sure you leave enough room for the boatway to be connected later.

**Build your farm anywhere in water and define the fishing area.**

Fishing Area is defined by placing nodes in any shape you like and then completing the area by selecting the opposite edge of the area.

**Fishing Route Tool is used to mark the directions for boats to go with in the boatway.**

With the Fishing Route Tool, select a Fishing Boat Berth node from the hub building's pier, and connected to the Fishing Areas or Open Water Fish Farming Areas you'd like the boats to visit.
Loop back to the hub building's Berth to complete the route.

The hub building upgrades include three sizes of cold storage buildings. They expand the company's storage space.

**The storage buildings can be placed anywhere on land, with in the hub building area circle.**

You can place as many storage units as you like and can fit with in the land area inside the circle. These storage buildings don't need a road connection to work.
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**The Offshore Oil Drilling accesses underwater oil deposits.**

Offshore Oil Drilling Hub building is build on land, on the coast line. It works as the main building for the Offshore Oil Drilling Area.

The hub building includes an integrated Oil Harbor Pier segment, which serves as the foundation for the full pier.
Tutorials.TITLE[OffshoreOilDrillingTutor: Building an Offshore Oil Drilling Hub
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Find a suitable place on the shoreline with underwater oil deposits not too far away.**

Use the Natural Resource info view to see where underwater oil deposits are located.

Offshore Oil Drilling Hub Buildings will also need a road connection so employees and resource trucks have access to it.
Tutorials.TRIGGER[OffshoreOilDrillingTut: Build an Offshore Oil Drilling Hub
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Offshore Oil Drilling Hub requires a road connection.**

Employees and resource trucks use the road to access the building. 

Remember build a good road connection for smooth operation, if you haven't already done so.

**When the road is connected a company can move in and start production.**

Select the Hub Building you've just build, to open the upgrade menu.

The upgrade menu includes important additions to the hub building that are required for the oil production to function.

**You'll need to close the Zones Menu first to be able to select the Building.**
Tutorials.TRIGGER[OffshoreOilDrillingTut: Select the Offshore Oil Drilling Hub
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**The Oil Harbor Pier has oil pipe connection points to connect to the Compliant Tower Oil Platforms.**

The pier also has Oil Tanker Berths for oil tankers transporting crude oil from the Semi-Submersible Oil Platform to shore.

The Oil Tanker Route Tool is used to create the oil tanker routes between the Offshore Oil Drilling Harbor and the Semi-Submersible Oil Platforms.

**Build the Oil Harbor Pier from the pier stub included in the hub building and extend it towards the open water.**

Once the pier is long enough, a narrow seaways will appear on both sides and the Oil Tanker Berths are created.

**Compliant Tower Oil Platforms drill oil from deposits close to the shoreline.**

The Compliant Tower Oil Platform has an integrated oil pipe connection points, to connect the platform to the hub building with an oil pipe.

When the pipe is connected oil will be transferred to the holding tanks on land.
Tutorials.TITLE[OffshoreOilDrillingTutor: Building a Compliant Tower Oil Platform
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Build the oil platform on top of an underwater oil deposit within range of the hub building.**

The hub building range is marked with a circle, find an oil deposits within the circled area.
Tutorials.TRIGGER[OffshoreOilDrillingTut: Build a Compliant Tower Oil Platform
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Oil Pipes connect Compliant Tower Oil Platforms and Offshore Oil Drilling hub buildings.**

The pipes transport crude oil from the oil platforms to the shore.
Tutorials.TITLE[OffshoreOilDrillingTutor: Connecting the Compliant Tower Oil Platform
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Connect the Compliant Tower Oil Platform to its hub building with the Oil Pipe.**

Once the connection has been made, the flow of crude oil is visualized on the pipe.
Tutorials.TRIGGER[OffshoreOilDrillingTut: Connect the Compliant Tower Oil Platform
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OffshoreOilDrillin:
**Semi-Submersible Oil Platforms drill for oil from underwater oil deposits further away from shoreline.**

The Semi-Submersible Oil Platform has an integrated Oil Tanker Berth which can be connected through a seaway to the Oil Tanker Berths of the hub building's Oil Harbor Pier.

**Build the oil platform on top of an underwater oil deposit within range of the hub building.**

The maximum distance away from the hub building for the oil platform is shown as a circle. Find an oil deposits within the circle and build the platform on top of it.

Keep an eye out for the route ships will need to take to get to the platform. That there is a clear way for the ships to navigate between the hub building and the platform.

**You will need a seaway for boats to transport the oil from the platform to the hub building.** 

Create a seaway that connects the Offshore Oil Drilling hub building and the Semi-Submersible Oil Platform.

**Oil Tanker Route Tool is used to mark the way for oil tankers to follow, with in the seaway.**

With the Oil Tanker Route Tool, select an Oil Tanker Berth in your Offshore Oil Drilling hub building, and connectected to the Semi-Submersible Oil Platform.

Loop back to the Offshore Oil Drilling hub building to complete the route.

**When the route is set tankers can start to transport oil to the hub building.**
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[DrawbridgesTutoria:
**Drawbridges have two rising spans to let ships pass underneath.**

Drawbridges come in various sizes, but they all operate the same way. They are designed for areas where road traffic intersects with waterway traffic.

When the bridge spans are lowered, road traffic can pass through as usual.

However, when a ship or other water-based vehicle approaches, the spans are lifted to allow unobstructed clearance. During this time, road traffic is temporarily halted until the spans are lowered again.

**This state will appear when the bridge crosses a seaway or a boatway.**
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[LiftBridgesTutoria:
**Lift bridges use a vertical lifting mechanism to let ships pass underneath.** 

They can support different types of traffic, like trains or vehicles. These bridges are perfect for connecting land routes without blocking waterway access.

When the bridge is down, trains and vehicles can cross normally. 

When a ship gets close, the bridge lifts straight up to make room. While it’s raised, all land traffic waits until the bridge comes back down.

**This state will appear when the bridge crosses a seaway or a boatway.**
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[CargoPortsTutorial: Cargo Container Yards store large amounts of resources like wood, plastics and textiles.
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[PassengerFerryTuto:
**Ferries use the city's waterways to transport passengers around the city**

They offer citizens and tourists alternative ways to get around the city and decrease traffic congestion.

**A good place to build your Ferry Depot is somewhere on a shoreline with good access to the city's waterways.**

Depots don't need to be in the immediate vicinity of the area where your ferries operate.

Ferry lines do not need to pass through depots, and a single depot can supply ferries for multiple lines.

**Make sure ferries going out from the depot have boatway access to your planned route, and that it's still close enough for efficienty operation.**

**Boatways are narrower than Seaways and therefore they are more convenient to use in smaller waterways.**

Connect the depot, stops, and the ferry terminals with the boatways to create the basis for ferry lines.

**Note:** When planning your route, you might need to replace low bridges with higher ones to let ships pass under them.

Ferries can travel on seaways, as well, but they operate only within city limits.

To create a Ferry Line you will need Ferry Stops, which ferries use to pick up and drop off passengers.

**Ferry Stops can be placed on quays and on shorelines,** wherever you want ferries to make a stop along the line.

**When built, Ferry Stops create a short segment of boatway which can be connected with the Boatway tool.**

**With the Ferry Line Tool, select each stop and terminal, in the order you would like the Ferry Line to operate.**

**Complete the loop by selecting the stop that you started the line with.**

The line will automatically follow the correct boatways as long as each stop and terminal is connected to the same boatway network.

**Note:** You can add new waypoints and stops and terminals after the line is complete.
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[CargoPortsTutorial: Pasenger Terminals built on top of port quays or port roads allow passengers to board and disembark, adding passenger transportation functionality to the Port area.

**Ports are customizable and more flexible alternative to the Cargo Harbor.**

Ports can also function as intermodal dry ports, featuring a very large storage space and cargo truck and cargo train connections.

**Port Main Gate functions as the Port's main building.**

There are three different-sized main gates available to choose from. The larger main gates have additional building extensions.

The Port Main Gate features integrated roads and controls traffic to and from the Port area. All vehicles interacting with the Port are required to pass through one of the gates when entering and exiting the port area.

**You can build the gates anywhere you like and add roads to them or attached them to existing roads.**

**Select the Port Main Gate to access the various building upgrades.**

The main functionality of the Port is achieved by placing the various sub-buildings into the port area.

**You'll need to close the Transportations Menu to be able to select the building.**

Road network planning and gate placement are some of the key aspects of Port functionality.

**Locate the front side of your Main Gate Building and start your planning.**

You can use any type of road, inside and outside of the gate building as long as both sides are connected so traffic can flow in and out through the gate.

Using the Port Roads inside the port area to create an internal road system can be beneficial to the areas efficiency.

**Port Roads give you more control of the traffic flow with in the port area.**

You can place Container Cranes on these roads, which support oversized loads leaving plenty of room for Reach Stackers to move along them.
The Intermodal Train Terminal adds a cargo train connection to the Port.
Tutorials.DESCRIPTION[OpenWaterFishFarmi:
**Boatways are pathways for boats.**

Boatways define an area on water where boats can be steered.

They are used to connect your Fishing Areas and Open Water Fish Farms.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P1_PARAGRAPH_1: Fish can be obtained through fishing and fish farming, with fish farms also available on land. To start, build hub buildings and define their areas. Then, connect these areas to their hub buildings using boatways and establish fishing boat lines. Once set up, you’ll be ready to gather fish for food production.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P1_PARAGRAPH_2: Off-shore Oil Drilling allows access to underwater oil deposits. Oil harbors support two types of oil platforms. The compliant tower oil platform is used close to the coastline and is connected to the oil harbor via an oil pipe. The semi-submersible oil platform can be built further into the sea and it is connected to the oil harbor by a seaway and an oil tanker route.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P2_PARAGRAPH_1: Leisure piers, found in the Landscaping menu, fulfill citizens' leisure needs while also being great addition for detailers' toolkit.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P2_PARAGRAPH_2: Build quays to define and enhance the shoreline and harbor areas. In addition to beautifying the city, they include built-in roads for vehicles and sidewalks for pedestrians.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P4_PARAGRAPH_1: The new draw and lift bridges provide excellent traffic management opportunities, allowing for smoother crossings over seaways.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P4_PARAGRAPH_2: Combination bridges offer versatile traffic solutions by integrating different road types and combining roads with rail in various configurations.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P5_PARAGRAPH_2: The four lighthouses are maritime-themed leisure buildings. The Old Lighthouse is a tourist attraction and a unique building with its own upgrades.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P6_PARAGRAPH_1: The 5 new maps are perfect for trying out the new features. Or you if you want, check what new opportunities are available in the already-familiar maps.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P7_PARAGRAPH_1: The passenger ferry is a new option for public transportation. The ferry depot supplies the ferries to the ferry lines. There are two ferry stop variants and the ferry terminal. One ferry stop can be placed on a quay while the other is placed directly on the shoreline. The stops can be connected either by road or pedestrian pathway and do not require utilities connections. The ferry terminal is placed on the shoreline and requires road and utilities access. After the stops are placed, connect them and the ferry depot with the boatway. To finalize the ferry transportation, connect the stops with the ferry line tool. Once set up, ferries start to transport citizens around the city.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P7_PARAGRAPH_2: The new parks featuring fun carnival rides and restaurants are leisure-themed buildings that fit right in with any city.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P3_PARAGRAPH_1: Boatways are narrow seaways where boats and ferries can operate. They can be used to connect fishing areas and open-water fish farms to their hub-buildings. The Fishing Line tool can then be used to create the fishing boat routes. Boatways can also be used to connect the ferry depot, ferry stops and terminals. The Ferry Line tool can then be used to create ferry lines that transport passengers around the city's waterways.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P0_PARAGRAPH_1: The new Ports offer more flexible ways to create bustling port areas in your cities, and their various upgrades expand their functionality even further.
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P5_SUB_TITLE_1: Signature Buildings - Commercial and Industrial Signature Buildings
WhatsNew.BRIDGES_PORTS_P5_PARAGRAPH_1: The new signature buildings are perfect additions to the maritime theme. The Seafarer Shipyards fit right in with the new ports, while the Fish and Chippery Seafood Factory processes locally caught fish into a variety of delicacies. Bait & Bistro brings the laid-back waterfront vibes into the city while Villa Maré oozes that Mediterranean atmosphere. The Maritime Museum showcases the history of sea travel while the Conference Center pulls in visitors from the city and abroad.
